# Two accepted prerequisite levels release their dependent.
# Literal digests were independently checked with Python hashlib and OpenSSL.
exec ctx orient --project bundle --allow-source docs
! stderr .
stdout 'Evaluation: complete; inventory: complete'
stdout 'acceptance: valid'
stdout 'acceptance check: pass'
stdout 'actor: workflow build-agent'
stdout 'decided at: 2026-09-15T15:00:00\+02:00'
stdout 'tested revision \(historical\): local-artifact leaf-build-123'
stdout 'accepted fingerprint: version 1'
stdout 'Human approvals:'
stdout 'actor: human Alice'
stdout 'decided at: 2026-09-15T16:00:00\+02:00'
stdout 'tested revision \(historical\): review-artifact reviewed-leaf-123'
stdout 'Requirements:'
stdout 'recordedSHA256: 7047822efc7d1bca9634e6211ba6b1facb23e31d4051508eb0b8f272d1436294'
stdout 'Evidence:'
stdout 'currentSHA256: 1ecbc7c3efb6dd79a5a27d2df920b8f7f4795322309eeeb3feeca92db539f084'
stdout 'readiness: ready; eligible: true'
stdout 'Edge 2: status: pass; cycle: false'

exec ctx orient --project bundle --allow-source docs --json
! stderr .
cp stdout result.json
jsonorientation result.json true
stdout '"status":"valid"'
stdout '"dependencies":\[\{"from":\{[^}]*"id":"dependent"[^}]*\},"to":\{[^}]*"id":"middle"'

stdout '"shortlist":\[\{[^}]*"id":"dependent"'

# A stale leaf blocks the dependent even though the middle's acceptance stays valid.
cp changed-evidence.md docs/evidence.md
exec ctx orient --project bundle --allow-source docs
! stderr .
stdout 'Evaluation: complete; inventory: complete'
stdout 'acceptance: stale'
stdout 'acceptance: valid'
stdout 'acceptance check: fail'
stdout 'snapshot_changed'
stdout 'dependencies: fail'
stdout 'readiness: blocked; eligible: false'
stdout 'Shortlist: none'
stdout 'tested revision \(historical\): local-artifact leaf-build-123'
exec ctx orient --project bundle --allow-source docs --json
! stderr .
cp stdout result.json
jsonorientation result.json true
stdout '"status":"stale"'
stdout '"code":"snapshot_changed"'
stdout '"shortlist":\[\]'
stdout '"testedRevision":\{"origin":"local-artifact","revision":"leaf-build-123"\}'

# Missing leaf evidence propagates unknown through the accepted middle.
rm docs/evidence.md
exit 1 ctx orient --project bundle --allow-source docs
! stderr .
stdout 'Evaluation: partial; inventory: complete'
stdout 'acceptance: unknown'
stdout 'acceptance check: unknown'
stdout 'actor: workflow build-agent'
stdout 'currentSHA256: unknown'
stdout 'recordedSHA256: 1ecbc7c3efb6dd79a5a27d2df920b8f7f4795322309eeeb3feeca92db539f084'
stdout 'snapshot_unavailable'
stdout 'dependencies: unknown'
stdout 'Shortlist: none'
exit 1 ctx orient --project bundle --allow-source docs --json
! stderr .
cp stdout result.json
jsonorientation result.json false
stdout '"status":"unknown"'
stdout '"currentSHA256":null'
stdout '"code":"snapshot_unavailable"'
stdout '"actor":\{"kind":"workflow","identity":"build-agent"\}'
stdout '"shortlist":\[\]'
